lee: Heads up: cert rotation caused a subtle handshake regression with runtime 2.7 on alpine nodes. Planning an emergency pin in ap-southeast-1 tonight to avoid client TLS failures.

monica: Can you confirm failure mode? 5xx or client-side tls errors?

gus: Seeing client TLS errors (ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL) from customers behind older proxies. Server logs show TLSv1.3 early_data rejects for runtime 2.7.2 builds.

lee: Proposed action: pin ap-southeast-1 to runtime=2.7.1, apply routing rule r-aps-284, schedule change window 2026-03-26T23:00Z-23:30Z. We'll follow with runtime 2.7.3 that disables early_data until full cert chain propagated.

devops: Ready to push routing. Need `/deploybot pin` command and audit reason.

lee: `/deploybot pin runtime=2.7.1 region=ap-southeast-1 reason="tls-early-data-regression" actor=lee`

deploybot: (bot) Command queued: pin-481111. Change window created: pin-window-4811. To execute: `/deploybot execute pin-481111`.

monica: Support note: prepare customer advisory that older proxy stacks may need to update openssl. Also mark SDKs that negotiate early_data differently as "check before upgrade".

gus: Quick smoke: after routing change we should validate handshake success rate >99.9% and no increase in client tls errors.

devops: Executing pin now. Routing r-aps-284 -> runtime=2.7.1 at 100% for pinned customers.

deploybot: (bot) Pin executed: pin-481111. Anchor ID anchor-aps-4811. Expires in 48h. Audit id audit-aps-4811.

lee: Observability (5m): handshake success improved from 98.4% -> 99.95%. No new customer tickets so far. Leaving anchor 48h while runtime 2.7.3 is built.

monica: I'll draft advisory and add SDK compatibility note: `redwood-sdk >=2.0` handles it but older SDKs may renegotiate differently.

gus: Opening PR for 2.7.3: disable early_data by default and add cert chain refresh check. Link when ready.

lee: Thanks team. We'll unpin after 2.7.3 rollout and cert propagation. Follow-up thread will include unpin schedule and postmortem.
